items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Clive said he sounds like album one and he talks about J.J. Johnson.

ctx.x: Yeah, he really disliked when we started playing this rasp and some soul man. So don't play that dead music. You want to play when the sings, you know.
Clive said he sounds like album one and he talks about J.J. Johnson.
Yeah, he likes that kind of his life. I played a jam session with him, Rolf and I, and the Japanese drummer who was here before.
